# LLMS.txt Index

> A minimal index of all `llms-*.txt` and `llms-*.md` documents, providing a brief summary and relational links for quick navigation and contextual understanding.

## Beyond Numerical Metrics
> Critiques purely numerical performance metrics and introduces the Managerial Moment of Truth (MMOT) as a superior qualitative approach.

## Delayed Resolution Principle
> Explains the principle of holding structural tension rather than prematurely resolving it, which is critical for the creative process.
- **Link**: [llms-delayed-resolution-principle.md](./llms-delayed-resolution-principle.md)
- **Related**: llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-structural-tension-charts.txt

## Deep Research Foundations — Session Close Protocol
> When a repo has a derived `deep-research-foundations` skill and a `./foundations/` tree, session close must compare implemented decisions against academic foundation fields, update `source-ledger.yaml` provenance if traceable, then make a scoped issue-referenced commit or state the blocker.
- **Link**: [llms-deep-research-foundations-session-close.md](./llms-deep-research-foundations-session-close.md)
- **Related**: llms-rise-framework.txt, llms-narrative-beats.txt

## Digital Decision Making Framework
> A guide for implementing the TandT (Twos and Threes) digital decision-making methodology to transform subjective analog thinking into structured binary evaluations.
- **Link**: [llms-digital-decision-making.md](./llms-digital-decision-making.md)
- **Related**: llms-structural-thinking.txt, llms-creative-orientation.txt

## Critique of "Supermind Ideator"
> A paradigmatic critique of an academic paper on AI for "creative problem-solving," arguing that its problem-solving bias distorts the nature of generative creativity.

## Academic Pollution Detection
> A short note identifying `llms-pollution-critique-arxiv-2311.01937v1.md` as an example of a new type of critique paper. Includes references to the Incompatible Sources Registry and the Agent Loop Architectures counter-article.
- **Link**: [llms-pollution-detection.md](./llms-pollution-detection.md)
- **Related**: llms-pollution-detection-checklist.md, llms-pollution-critique-arxiv-2311.01937v1.md, counter_articles/incompatible-sources/README.md, counter_articles/agent-loop-architectures-counter-article.md

## Paradigm Pollution Detection Checklist
> A structured, operational checklist for assessing whether a source embeds paradigmatic assumptions incompatible with creative-orientation, relational, and ceremonial frameworks. Anchored in the core insight that "Creative Problem Solving" is a fiction — the compound term conflates two structurally incompatible orientations. Produces severity scores and paradigm_compatibility ratings. Includes contextual discrimination guidance (recognizing that over-reacting against problem-solving is itself problem-solving), and a worked example using arXiv:2311.01937v1.
- **Link**: [llms-pollution-detection-checklist.md](./llms-pollution-detection-checklist.md)
- **Related**: llms-pollution-detection.md, counter_articles/incompatible-sources/README.md, llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-epistemological-counter-article-protocol.md

## Incompatible Sources Registry
> A curated index of academic and industry sources whose epistemological, ontological, or methodological foundations are fundamentally incompatible with the creative-orientation, relational, and ceremonial paradigms. Key paradigmatic fiction identified: "Creative Problem Solving" conflates creating and reacting into one category, erasing creation as a distinct structural orientation. Makes paradigmatic divergence visible and explicit.
- **Link**: [counter_articles/incompatible-sources/README.md](./counter_articles/incompatible-sources/README.md)
- **Related**: llms-pollution-detection.md, llms-pollution-critique-arxiv-2311.01937v1.md, llms-epistemological-counter-article-protocol.md

## Agent Loop Architectures: Problem-Solving vs. Creative Orientation
> A paradigmatic analysis of AI agent orchestration engines, examining how structural assumptions in agent loop design determine whether systems produce oscillating or advancing patterns. Positions creative orientation as a generative alternative.
- **Link**: [counter_articles/agent-loop-architectures-counter-article.md](./counter_articles/agent-loop-architectures-counter-article.md)
- **Related**: llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-structural-thinking.txt, llms-pde.txt, llms-ceremony-pipeline.md, llms-pollution-detection.md


## RISE Framework
> The RISE (Reverse-engineer, Intent-extract, Specify, Export) framework is a method for creative-oriented analysis and generation of code architectures.
- **Link**: [llms-rise-framework.txt](./llms-rise-framework.txt)
- **Related**: llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-structural-thinking.txt, llms-managerial-moment-of-truth.md

## Macrostructural Patterning Analysis (SCCP)
> A guide for using Robert Fritz's Structural Dynamics to identify and understand recurring behavioral patterns (macrostructural patterning).
- **Link**: [llms-sccp-patterning.md](./llms-sccp-patterning.md)
- **Related**: llms-creative-orientation.txt

## Structural Tension Charts Guide
> A guide for understanding and using Robert Fritz's structural tension charts. Structural tension is **disequilibrium** — an active, loaded force that resolves through advancement (NOT "a gap to bridge"). Action steps are telescoped sub-charts, not a to-do list.
- **Link**: [llms-structural-tension-charts.txt](./llms-structural-tension-charts.txt)
- **Related**: llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-delayed-resolution-principle.md, llms-managerial-moment-of-truth.md


## Structural Thinking - CURRENT
> The comprehensive guide to Robert Fritz's Structural Thinking for LLMs. Integrates FST/SCCP source materials, three-universe validation (Mia/Miette/Ava), Indigenous paradigm as ceremonial technology, PDE template with Four Directions mapping. Supersedes both Gemini and Claude versions.
- **Link**: [llms-structural-thinking.txt](./llms-structural-thinking.txt)
- **Related**: llms-structural-tension-charts.txt, llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-rise-framework.txt, llms-delayed-resolution-principle.md, llms-managerial-moment-of-truth.md, llms-pde.txt

## Prompt Decomposition Engine (PDE)
> Intention exploration as EAST practice: decomposing prompts into explicit and implicit intents mapped to Four Directions. Includes current `miaco decompose run` strategy guidance (`standard`, `iterative-refinement`, `adversarial-consensus`), mcp-pde compatibility boundaries, knowledge base enrichment via qmd, and Structural Thinking Four Questions generation from decomposition ambiguities.
- **Link**: [llms-pde.txt](./llms-pde.txt)
- **Related**: llms-pde-structural-thinking.md, llms-st-four-questions.md, llms-creative-orientation.txt, llms-delayed-resolution-principle.md, llms-ceremony-pipeline.md, llms-polyphonic-design-review.md, llms-inquiry-routing.md

## PDE → Structural Thinking Bridge
> Links EAST decomposition to SOUTH planning via the Four Questions. PDE surfaces ambiguities; Information, Clarification, Implication, and Discrepancy questions transform them into structured inquiry before action begins.
- **Link**: [llms-pde-structural-thinking.md](./llms-pde-structural-thinking.md)
- **Related**: llms-pde.txt, llms-st-four-questions.md, llms-structural-thinking.txt, llms-ceremony-pipeline.md
